title: You as an Operating System
summary: Your life runs an OS: habits are daemons, goals are processes, attention is CPU, energy is battery.
body:
Personal OS: the operating system of one human life — how you schedule time, manage energy, permission your attention, and keep yourself running. Self-management as systems engineering.

Your life runs an OS: habits are daemons, goals are processes, attention is CPU, energy is battery. Most people run an unpatched, unmonitored OS. This database is the admin manual.

title: Time Scheduling: Your Calendar Kernel
summary: Time-block your calendar like a scheduler: deep work gets priority interrupts disabled, shallow work batches, and buffers absorb overruns.

Time-block your calendar like a scheduler: deep work gets priority interrupts disabled, shallow work batches, and buffers absorb overruns. If it's not scheduled, it's not real.

program.code:
# Round-robin scheduler: the OS concept behind fair task sharing
from collections import deque
def round_robin(tasks, quantum=2):
    q = deque((name, burst) for name, burst in tasks)
    t = 0
    while q:
        name, burst = q.popleft()
        run = min(quantum, burst)
        t += run; burst -= run
        print(f"t={t:3d}  {name} ran {run} (remaining {burst})")
        if burst: q.append((name, burst))
round_robin([("email",5),("report",3),("calls",4)])

title: Energy Management: The Battery
summary: Time is fixed; energy isn't.
body:
Time is fixed; energy isn't. Manage the battery: sleep (charging), exercise (capacity), nutrition (fuel quality), breaks (thermal management). Schedule hard tasks at peak charge.

title: Habits: The Daemon Army
summary: Habits are background daemons: they run without CPU (willpower).
body:
Habits are background daemons: they run without CPU (willpower). Install good ones (exercise, reading), kill bad ones (doomscrolling), and never rely on foreground willpower for background jobs.

title: Inbox Zero: Buffer Management
summary: Inboxes are buffers: email, messages, tasks.
body:
Inboxes are buffers: email, messages, tasks. Unbounded buffers overflow (anxiety). Process to zero regularly: delete, delegate, defer, do. The buffer is not storage.
